faq: Can you put a hard cap on spending?
Yes, where the provider supports it. We set spending limits in the model or tool account itself, plus a second limit inside the agent, so one failure does not remove the other.
What happens when the agent hits a limit?
It stops that action, records why and alerts the person you name. It does not look for a way around the limit. You can raise a limit later by editing one setting.
Do limits make the agent useless?
Good limits should not. We set them from what the agent really needs, then test with real work. If a limit blocks normal tasks, we adjust it in the revision period.
Can you apply limits to an agent someone else built?
Often yes, if we can see its settings and get collaborator access. We review it first and tell you which limits can be added without a rebuild.
